## What changed

Describe the behavior or documentation change and link the issue (for example, `Closes #123`).

## How I checked it

List the commands you ran and their results. Explain any checks you could not run.

## Evidence and data safety

- [ ] New fixtures are synthetic; no real documents, personal data, or secrets are included.
- [ ] Source page and region provenance is preserved where relevant.
- [ ] Documentation matches the current behavior, including limitations.
- [ ] Evaluation claims cite a reproducible report, if this PR makes any.

## Notes for reviewers

Call out design decisions, tradeoffs, and anything that needs a closer look.
